en: Black-and-white view of a European town square with historic gabled houses and a church tower in the background. The buildings have steep tiled roofs and multiple dormer windows. Large painted shop signs in German are visible on the facades, including a prominent triangular-gabled building on the right with decorative garlands and reliefs, and multi-storey houses on the left with commercial storefronts at street level. A narrow lane runs between the central buildings toward the church tower. A few people and a cart are visible in the open cobbled square.
